summary_en: Net Protections Holdings authorized acquisition of up to 3.5 million shares (3.5% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 1.2 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 17, 2026 through May 17, 2027. All acquired shares will be canceled.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 16, 2026, the Board of Directors of Net Protections Holdings resolved to acquire up to 3.5 million shares of the company's common stock through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, representing 3.5% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). The maximum acquisition cost is set at 1.2 billion yen, with the acquisition period running from November 17, 2026 to May 17, 2027, using a discretionary trading method. All shares acquired will be canceled as of May 31, 2027.

The company stated that the acquisition is intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. This decision is based on the company's policy outlined in its March 2026 earnings presentation, which emphasized that shareholder returns would be considered flexibly in balance with growth investments. The company emphasized that its core business—post-payment settlement services for both B2C and B2B customers—has relatively short debt and receivable turnover periods and does not require substantial increases in working capital as the business grows. Therefore, the company believes this acquisition will not impede planned business investments or growth strategies outlined in its medium-term management plan.

The company stated that funding for the acquisition will come from existing cash on hand. The company noted that execution of some or all orders may not occur depending on market conditions.
